001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
004import lombok.Data;
005import lombok.EqualsAndHashCode;
006
007/**
008 * QuickShop chat handling event
009 *
010 * @author Ghost_chu
011 */
012@EqualsAndHashCode(callSuper = true)
013@Data
014public class QSHandleChatEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
015
016  private final QUser sender;
017  private String message;
018
019  public QSHandleChatEvent(final QUser sender, final String message) {
020
021    this.sender = sender;
022    this.message = message;
023  }
024
025  /**
026   * Getting the player chat content
027   *
028   * @return The chat content
029   */
030  public String getMessage() {
031
032    return message;
033  }
034
035  /**
036   * Sets the new player chat content that pass to the QuickShop
037   *
038   * @param message The new chat content
039   */
040  public void setMessage(final String message) {
041
042    this.message = message;
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Getting the chat sender
047   *
048   * @return The chat sender
049   */
050  public QUser getSender() {
051
052    return sender;
053  }
054}
